import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income distribution by Education
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
education_order = df.groupby('Education')['Income'].median().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='Education', x='Income', order=education_order, ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Income')

# 2. Total spending by customer
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
df['TotalSpending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
ax2.hist(df['TotalSpending'], bins=30, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Total Customer Spending', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Total Spending')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 3. Spending by category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
spending_by_category = df[spending_cols].sum()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(spending_by_category)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(spending_by_category, labels=[col.replace('Mnt', '') for col in spending_cols], 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Spending Distribution by Product Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Age distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
ax4.hist(df['Age'], bins=25, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age')
ax4.set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 5. Marital Status distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
ax5.bar(range(len(marital_counts)), marital_counts.values, color='lightgreen', edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(marital_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(marital_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax5.set_title('Customer Marital Status Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')

# 6. Purchase channels comparison
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
purchase_channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
channel_totals = df[purchase_channels].sum()
ax6.bar([ch.replace('Num', '').replace('Purchases', '') for ch in purchase_channels], 
        channel_totals.values, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1'], edgecolor='black')
ax6.set_title('Total Purchases by Channel', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Purchases')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 7. Income vs Total Spending scatter
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], alpha=0.5, c='purple', s=30)
ax7.set_title('Income vs Total Spending', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Income')
ax7.set_ylabel('Total Spending')

# 8. Number of children vs spending
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
df['TotalChildren'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
children_spending = df.groupby('TotalChildren')['TotalSpending'].mean()
ax8.bar(children_spending.index, children_spending.values, color='orange', edgecolor='black')
ax8.set_title('Average Spending by Number of Children', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Total Children')
ax8.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending')

# 9. Campaign acceptance rate
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
campaign_acceptance = df[campaign_cols].sum()
ax9.bar(range(len(campaign_acceptance)), campaign_acceptance.values, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
ax9.set_xticks(range(len(campaign_acceptance)))
ax9.set_xticklabels(['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Response'], rotation=45)
ax9.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_ylabel('Number of Acceptances')

plt.suptitle('Customer Marketing Data Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
